name: coliseum
title: coliseum
blurb: paste a bsky post link (or a handle) and it fills a coliseum with the thread underneath: the two loudest replies step onto the floor and fight, everyone else fills the stands on whichever side they replied to, or stands neutral in the middle. @jefferyharrell.bsky.social asked for "a bsky viewer that gives me a coliseum stands view of everyone fighting it out."
